::: {.callout-note title="Using the prototype" collapse="true"}

Place one `.qmd` file, one `.pdf` file, or both in `to_be_reviewed/`. Set the filenames, assignment, and one model in `runtime-params`; then run `runtime-params`, `setup-r`, `setup-py`, and `anthropic-review-manual`. Render the report to display the latest saved review. The review instructions are in `prompt.md`, next to this file.

The output is a first pass before the required human product review. It can identify likely issues and questions, but it does not approve the product. Checks that depend on an RAP/SAP, source data, or other material are limited to what is supplied.

Rendering never starts an API request because the request chunk is `eval=FALSE`.

**Model**

Set exactly one value in `anthropic_model`:

- `claude-opus-5-5`
- `claude-fable-5-2`

Only the selected model is run and displayed. `anthropic_effort = "high"` is the standard setting; use `xhigh` or `max` only when the review warrants the additional token use.

Claude Fable 5.2 requires 30-day data retention and is not available under zero data retention. Use it only in an approved workspace and for material permitted under the applicable institutional arrangements.

**API key**

The Anthropic Python SDK reads `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` from the environment. Never share API keys or commit them to version control. In RStudio, the key can be stored in `~/.Renviron`:

```bash
cat >> ~/.Renviron <<'EOF'
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
EOF
```

```{r api-key-check, echo=FALSE}

mask_key <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || !nzchar(x)) return("(missing)")
  n <- nchar(x)
  if (n <= 8) return(strrep("*", n))
  paste0(substr(x, 1, 4), strrep("*", n - 8), substr(x, n - 3, n))
}

anthropic_key <- Sys.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", unset = "")

key_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY",
  Status = ifelse(nzchar(anthropic_key), "found", "missing"),
  Preview = mask_key(anthropic_key),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(key_df, align = c("l", "l", "l"))
```

**Main settings**

| Setting | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `review_folder` | Folder containing the current review set. Default: `to_be_reviewed`. |
| `pdf_file` | Optional PDF filename. Leave blank only when at most one `.pdf` is present. |
| `qmd_file` | Optional QMD filename. Leave blank only when at most one `.qmd` is present. |
| `assignment` | Optional issues or questions to answer explicitly. |
| `code_context_mode` | Source context: `code_only`, `full_text`, or `none`. |
| `max_code_chars` | Hard safety ceiling for the complete selected QMD context. Set `0` for no ceiling. If the ceiling is exceeded, setup stops; the source is never clipped. |
| `prompt_addendum` | Extra instructions appended to the generated prompt. |
| `prompt_override` | Replaces the review instructions in `prompt.md` when non-empty. Assignment and source-integrity blocks are still appended. |
| `anthropic_model` | The single model used for the review. |
| `anthropic_stream` | Whether to stream the response interactively; required when `max_output_tokens` exceeds 21,333. |
| `anthropic_effort` | `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, or `max`. |
| `anthropic_display` | Thinking summary display: `summarized` or `omitted`. |
| `max_output_tokens` | Output cap including thinking and visible response. |
| `pricing_usd_per_1m` | Rates used for the cost estimate. |

The default `full_text` mode includes the complete raw QMD. With `code_context_mode = "code_only"`, every executable code chunk is included in full, together with its original header, chunk options, and source-line range; only QMD prose is intentionally omitted. `none` intentionally sends no QMD source context. A positive `max_code_chars` value is a hard preflight limit: the setup stops rather than cutting a function or chunk. For a supplied QMD, the prompt ends with a completion token that the model must return and the runner verifies before the review is marked complete. A supplied PDF is attached in all three modes.
:::

## Setup


```{r runtime-params, include=FALSE}

cfg <- list(
  review_folder = "to_be_reviewed",
  pdf_file = "",
  qmd_file = "",

  assignment = "",

  # Options: "code_only", "full_text", "none"
  # full_text is the safest default: the complete raw QMD is submitted.
  code_context_mode = "full_text",

  # 0 = no character ceiling. A positive value is a hard limit:
  # setup stops instead of truncating the QMD context.
  max_code_chars = 0,

  prompt_addendum = "",
  prompt_override = "",

  # Choose exactly one model for the review:
  # "claude-opus-5-5" or "claude-fable-5-2"
  anthropic_model = "claude-opus-5-5",
  anthropic_stream = TRUE,
  anthropic_effort = "high",
  anthropic_display = "summarized",

  max_output_tokens = 64000,

  # Standard API rates in USD per 1M tokens (list prices, November 2026).
  pricing_usd_per_1m = data.frame(
    model = c(
      "claude-opus-5-5",
      "claude-fable-5-2"
    ),
    input = c(4, 8),
    output = c(20, 40),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)
```

```{r setup-r, include=FALSE}

# Use reticulate's managed Python environment.
Sys.setenv(RETICULATE_PYTHON = "managed")

library(reticulate)

# Python dependency for the review request.
py_require(
  packages = c(
    "anthropic"
  ),
  python_version = ">=3.10,<3.13",
  exclude_newer = "2026-07-09",
  action = "set"
)


# py_require()

if (!exists("cfg") || !is.list(cfg)) {
  stop("cfg not found. Run the 'runtime-params' chunk first.")
}

if (!dir.exists(cfg$review_folder)) {
  ok <- dir.create(cfg$review_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (!ok && !dir.exists(cfg$review_folder)) {
    stop("review_folder not found and could not be created: ", cfg$review_folder)
  }
}

resolve_optional_file <- function(folder, param_file, pattern, label, cfg_name) {
  if (!is.null(param_file) && nzchar(trimws(param_file))) {
    path <- file.path(folder, param_file)
    if (!file.exists(path)) {
      stop(label, " not found: ", path)
    }
    return(normalizePath(path))
  }

  matches <- list.files(
    folder,
    pattern = pattern,
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
  if (length(matches) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  info <- file.info(matches)
  matches <- matches[!is.na(info$isdir) & !info$isdir]
  matches <- sort(matches)

  if (length(matches) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  if (length(matches) > 1) {
    stop(
      "Multiple ", label, " files found in ", folder, ": ",
      paste(basename(matches), collapse = ", "),
      ". Set cfg$", cfg_name, " explicitly in 'runtime-params'."
    )
  }

  normalizePath(matches[[1]])
}

pdf_path <- resolve_optional_file(
  cfg$review_folder, cfg$pdf_file, "\\.pdf$", "PDF", "pdf_file"
)
qmd_path <- resolve_optional_file(
  cfg$review_folder, cfg$qmd_file, "\\.qmd$", "QMD", "qmd_file"
)

no_input_mode <- is.na(qmd_path) && is.na(pdf_path)
if (no_input_mode) {
  doc_name <- "no_input_selected"
} else if (!is.na(qmd_path)) {
  doc_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(qmd_path))
} else {
  doc_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(pdf_path))
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}

read_latest_meta <- function(provider, doc_name, expected_model = "") {
  if (isTRUE(no_input_mode)) return(NULL)
  if (!requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) return(NULL)
  slug <- tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", doc_name))
  slug <- gsub("^_+|_+$", "", slug)
  runs_dir_local <- file.path("review_results", "prototype_runs")
  if (!dir.exists(runs_dir_local)) return(NULL)
  pattern <- paste0("^", slug, "_", provider, "_.*\\.json$")
  files <- list.files(runs_dir_local, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(files) == 0) return(NULL)

  info <- file.info(files)
  files <- rownames(info)[order(info$mtime, decreasing = TRUE)]

  expected_model <- trimws(as.character(expected_model %||% ""))
  if (nzchar(expected_model)) {
    for (f in files) {
      meta <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(f), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(meta)) next
      model_val <- if (is.null(meta$model) || length(meta$model) == 0 || is.na(meta$model[[1]])) {
        ""
      } else {
        as.character(meta$model[[1]])
      }
      if (identical(trimws(model_val), expected_model)) return(meta)
    }
    return(NULL)
  }

  tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(files[[1]]), error = function(e) NULL)
}

estimate_cost <- function(meta, pricing_tbl) {
  if (is.null(meta)) return(NA_real_)
  model <- as.character(meta$model %||% "")
  in_tok <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(meta$input_tokens %||% NA))
  out_tok <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(meta$output_tokens %||% NA))
  stop_reason <- as.character(meta$stop_reason %||% "")
  row <- pricing_tbl[pricing_tbl$model == model, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(row) == 0 || is.na(in_tok) || is.na(out_tok)) return(NA_real_)
  input_rate <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(row$input[1]))
  output_rate <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(row$output[1]))
  if (is.na(input_rate) || is.na(output_rate)) return(NA_real_)
  if (identical(stop_reason, "refusal") && out_tok == 0) return(0)
  (in_tok / 1e6) * input_rate + (out_tok / 1e6) * output_rate
}

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(y)
  v <- x[[1]]
  if (is.na(v)) return(y)
  if (is.character(v) && !nzchar(trimws(v))) return(y)
  v
}

anthropic_meta <- read_latest_meta("anthropic", doc_name, cfg$anthropic_model)
total_cost <- estimate_cost(anthropic_meta, cfg$pricing_usd_per_1m)
total_cost_text <- if (is.finite(total_cost) && total_cost >= 0) sprintf("$%.4f", total_cost) else "(n/a)"
doc_display <- if (isTRUE(no_input_mode)) {
  "(no input selected)"
} else {
  paste(na.omit(c(basename(qmd_path), basename(pdf_path))), collapse = " + ")
}
anthropic_model_display <- cfg$anthropic_model
anthropic_effort_display <- cfg$anthropic_effort %||% "(default)"
assignment_display <- trimws(as.character(cfg$assignment %||% ""))

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  html_escape <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x
  }
  cat("<div class='run-summary-strip'>\n")
  cat("<div class='run-summary-item'><span class='run-summary-label'><i class='bi bi-file-earmark-text' aria-hidden='true'></i> Document: </span><span class='run-summary-value'>", html_escape(doc_display), "</span></div>\n", sep = "")
  cat("<div class='run-summary-item'><span class='run-summary-label'><i class='bi bi-lightning-charge' aria-hidden='true'></i> Model: </span><span class='run-summary-value'>", html_escape(anthropic_model_display), "</span></div>\n", sep = "")
  cat("<div class='run-summary-item'><span class='run-summary-label'><i class='bi bi-speedometer2' aria-hidden='true'></i> Effort: </span><span class='run-summary-value'>", html_escape(anthropic_effort_display), "</span></div>\n", sep = "")
  cat("<div class='run-summary-item'><span class='run-summary-label'><i class='bi bi-cash-stack' aria-hidden='true'></i> Estimated cost: </span><span class='run-summary-value'>", html_escape(total_cost_text), "</span></div>\n", sep = "")
  cat("</div>\n")
  if (nzchar(assignment_display)) {
    assignment_html <- gsub("\n", "<br>", html_escape(assignment_display), fixed = TRUE)
    cat("<div class='run-summary-extra'>\n")
    cat("<span class='run-summary-extra-label'><i class='bi bi-chat-left-text' aria-hidden='true'></i> Assignment</span>\n")
    cat("<div class='run-summary-extra-value'>", assignment_html, "</div>\n", sep = "")
    cat("</div>\n")
  }
} else {
  run_summary_df <- data.frame(
    Field = c("Document", "Model", "Effort", "Estimated cost"),
    Value = c(doc_display, anthropic_model_display, anthropic_effort_display, total_cost_text),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if (nzchar(assignment_display)) {
    run_summary_df <- rbind(
      run_summary_df,
      data.frame(
        Field = "Assignment",
        Value = assignment_display,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
  print(knitr::kable(run_summary_df, align = c("l", "l")))
}

if (isTRUE(no_input_mode)) {
  cat("\n::: {.callout-warning title='No Input Document Found'}\n")
  cat("No `.qmd` or `.pdf` file was found in `", cfg$review_folder, "`. The report rendered in preview mode with no provider output loaded.\n", sep = "")
  cat("Set `review_folder` plus `qmd_file` and/or `pdf_file` in `runtime-params`, then re-run `runtime-params`, `setup-r`, and `setup-py`.\n")
  cat(":::\n")
}

::: {.callout-note title="API requests" collapse="true"}

These chunks define helper functions, prompt assembly, and provider API persistence logic.
Provider API chunks remain `eval=FALSE` during document render. Chunk labels/options are kept in the opening chunk headers for RStudio compatibility.

**Python Helpers and Prompt Assembly**

```{python setup-py}

import json
import re
import inspect
import hashlib
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path


def now_utc_stamp() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")


def now_utc_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def slug(text: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9]+", "_", text).strip("_").lower()


def sha256_text(text: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256((text or "").encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def sha256_file(path: Path | None):
    if path is None or not path.exists():
        return None
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def obj_to_dict(obj):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        return obj
    for attr in ("model_dump", "to_dict", "dict"):
        if hasattr(obj, attr):
            try:
                out = getattr(obj, attr)()
                if isinstance(out, dict):
                    return out
            except Exception:
                pass
    return {"_raw": str(obj)}


def _dedupe_keep_order(items):
    out = []
    for x in items:
        k = str(x).strip()
        if not k:
            continue
        if k != "[redacted_thinking]":
            # Drop low-information fragment leftovers (e.g., single trailing words).
            if len(k) < 12:
                continue
            if len(k) < 20 and not re.search(r"\s|[.!?:;,\-]", k):
                continue
        out.append(k)
    return out


def normalize_reasoning_text(text) -> str:
    s = str(text) if text is not None else ""
    s = s.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
    s = re.sub(r"[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f]", "", s)
    s = re.sub(r"[ \t]+\n", "\n", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", s)
    return s.strip()


def extract_anthropic_reasoning(resp) -> list:
    """Best-effort extraction of reasoning snippets from Anthropic response content blocks."""
    snippets = []
    for block in getattr(resp, "content", []):
        b = obj_to_dict(block)
        btype = b.get("type", getattr(block, "type", None))
        if btype == "thinking":
            txt = (
                b.get("thinking") or b.get("summary") or b.get("text") or
                getattr(block, "thinking", None) or getattr(block, "summary", None) or getattr(block, "text", None)
            )
            if isinstance(txt, str):
                snippets.append(txt)
            elif isinstance(txt, list):
                for part in txt:
                    if isinstance(part, str):
                        snippets.append(part)
                    elif isinstance(part, dict):
                        if isinstance(part.get("text"), str):
                            snippets.append(part.get("text"))
                        elif isinstance(part.get("thinking"), str):
                            snippets.append(part.get("thinking"))
            elif txt:
                snippets.append(str(txt))
        elif btype == "redacted_thinking":
            snippets.append("[redacted_thinking]")
    snippets = [normalize_reasoning_text(s) for s in snippets]
    return _dedupe_keep_order(snippets)


def anthropic_usage_value(usage, name: str) -> int:
    if usage is None:
        return 0
    if isinstance(usage, dict):
        return int(usage.get(name, 0) or 0)
    return int(getattr(usage, name, 0) or 0)


def count_text_lines(text: str) -> int:
    if not text:
        return 0
    return text.count("\n") + (0 if text.endswith("\n") else 1)


def parse_qmd_executable_chunks(qmd_text: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Return every executable Quarto chunk in full, with source locations.

    The parser never shortens a chunk. It raises an error for an unclosed
    executable chunk so an incomplete source cannot be submitted silently.
    """
    lines = qmd_text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    chunks = []
    i = 0
    start_re = re.compile(r"^\s*(`{3,}|~{3,})\{([^}]*)\}\s*(?:\r?\n)?$")

    while i < len(lines):
        match = start_re.match(lines[i])
        if not match:
            i += 1
            continue

        fence = match.group(1)
        spec = match.group(2).strip()
        first_token = re.split(r"[\s,]+", spec, maxsplit=1)[0] if spec else ""

        # Raw blocks such as ```{=html} are not executable chunks.
        if not first_token or first_token.startswith(("=", ".")):
            i += 1
            continue

        close_re = re.compile(
            rf"^\s*{re.escape(fence[0])}{{{len(fence)},}}\s*(?:\r?\n)?$"
        )
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(lines) and not close_re.match(lines[j]):
            j += 1

        if j >= len(lines):
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Unclosed executable QMD chunk beginning at source line {i + 1}: "
                f"{lines[i].strip()}"
            )

        main_spec = spec.split(",", 1)[0].strip()
        spec_parts = main_spec.split()
        language = spec_parts[0] if spec_parts else first_token
        label = spec_parts[1] if len(spec_parts) > 1 else f"unnamed_{len(chunks) + 1}"
        chunk_text = "".join(lines[i : j + 1])

        chunks.append(
            {
                "index": len(chunks) + 1,
                "language": language,
                "label": label,
                "start_line": i + 1,
                "end_line": j + 1,
                "text": chunk_text,
            }
        )
        i = j + 1

    return chunks


def extract_qmd_code_only(qmd_text: str) -> dict:
    chunks = parse_qmd_executable_chunks(qmd_text)
    rendered = []
    total = len(chunks)

    for chunk in chunks:
        rendered.append(
            "<!-- QMD CHUNK "
            f"{chunk['index']}/{total}; "
            f"label={chunk['label']}; "
            f"language={chunk['language']}; "
            f"source_lines={chunk['start_line']}-{chunk['end_line']} -->"
        )
        rendered.append(chunk["text"].rstrip("\r\n"))
        rendered.append("")

    return {
        "text": "\n".join(rendered).rstrip(),
        "chunks": chunks,
    }

# Paths from R setup
qmd_path_raw = r.qmd_path
qmd_path = None
if isinstance(qmd_path_raw, str) and qmd_path_raw not in {"", "NA"}:
    qmd_path = Path(qmd_path_raw)
doc_name = str(r.doc_name)
cfg = r.cfg

if not hasattr(cfg, "get"):
    raise RuntimeError("cfg is missing or invalid. Run 'runtime-params' then 'setup-r'.")


def cfg_required(name: str):
    if name not in cfg:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Missing cfg['{name}']. Edit 'runtime-params', then re-run 'setup-r' and 'setup-py'."
        )
    return cfg[name]


def cfg_str(name: str, allow_empty: bool = True) -> str:
    val = cfg_required(name)
    if val is None:
        if allow_empty:
            return ""
        raise RuntimeError(f"cfg['{name}'] is NULL. Set it in 'runtime-params'.")
    s = str(val)
    if not allow_empty and not s.strip():
        raise RuntimeError(f"cfg['{name}'] is empty. Set it in 'runtime-params'.")
    return s


def cfg_int(name: str, min_value: int | None = None) -> int:
    val = cfg_required(name)
    try:
        i = int(val)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise RuntimeError(f"cfg['{name}'] must be an integer, got: {val!r}") from exc
    if min_value is not None and i < min_value:
        raise RuntimeError(f"cfg['{name}'] must be >= {min_value}, got: {i}")
    return i


def cfg_bool(name: str) -> bool:
    val = cfg_required(name)
    if isinstance(val, bool):
        return val
    if isinstance(val, (int, float)):
        return bool(val)
    s = str(val).strip().lower()
    if s in {"true", "t", "1", "yes", "y"}:
        return True
    if s in {"false", "f", "0", "no", "n"}:
        return False
    raise RuntimeError(f"cfg['{name}'] must be TRUE/FALSE, got: {val!r}")


# Provider/runtime values (single source of truth = cfg from runtime-params)
anthropic_model = cfg_str("anthropic_model", allow_empty=False)
anthropic_stream = cfg_bool("anthropic_stream")
anthropic_effort = cfg_str("anthropic_effort", allow_empty=True).strip().lower()
anthropic_display = cfg_str("anthropic_display", allow_empty=True).strip().lower()
max_output_tokens = cfg_int("max_output_tokens", min_value=1)

allowed_review_models = {"claude-opus-5-5", "claude-fable-5-2"}
if anthropic_model not in allowed_review_models:
    allowed = ", ".join(sorted(allowed_review_models))
    raise RuntimeError(f"cfg['anthropic_model'] must be one of: {allowed}.")

pdf_path_raw = r.pdf_path
pdf_path = None
if isinstance(pdf_path_raw, str) and pdf_path_raw not in {"", "NA"}:
    pdf_path = Path(pdf_path_raw)

# Build QMD context without silent clipping.
raw_qmd = ""
if qmd_path is not None and qmd_path.exists():
    raw_qmd = qmd_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

qmd_sha256 = sha256_file(qmd_path)
pdf_sha256 = sha256_file(pdf_path)
context_mode = cfg_str("code_context_mode", allow_empty=False).lower()
max_code_chars = cfg_int("max_code_chars", min_value=0)

if context_mode not in {"code_only", "full_text", "none"}:
    raise RuntimeError("cfg['code_context_mode'] must be one of: code_only, full_text, none.")

parsed_qmd = extract_qmd_code_only(raw_qmd) if raw_qmd else {"text": "", "chunks": []}
qmd_chunks_total = len(parsed_qmd["chunks"])
qmd_chunks_included = 0
qmd_context_scope = "not supplied"
qmd_context_status = "not_applicable"
qmd_context_required = qmd_path is not None and context_mode != "none"

if qmd_path is None:
    code_context = ""
elif context_mode == "none":
    code_context = ""
    qmd_context_scope = "intentionally omitted by code_context_mode='none'"
    qmd_context_status = "intentionally_omitted"
elif context_mode == "full_text":
    code_context = raw_qmd
    qmd_chunks_included = qmd_chunks_total
    qmd_context_scope = "complete raw QMD: prose, chunk headers/options, and code"
    qmd_context_status = "complete"
else:
    code_context = parsed_qmd["text"]
    qmd_chunks_included = qmd_chunks_total
    qmd_context_scope = "all executable QMD chunks in full; prose intentionally omitted"
    qmd_context_status = "complete"

if qmd_context_required:
    if max_code_chars > 0 and len(code_context) > max_code_chars:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Complete QMD context is "
            f"{len(code_context):,} characters, exceeding cfg['max_code_chars']="
            f"{max_code_chars:,}. Nothing was submitted and no source was truncated. "
            "Set max_code_chars = 0 or increase the limit, then re-run setup-py."
        )

    if context_mode == "code_only" and qmd_chunks_total == 0 and pdf_path is None:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "code_context_mode='code_only' found no executable chunks and no PDF was supplied. "
            "Use code_context_mode='full_text' or provide the rendered PDF."
        )

    if qmd_chunks_included != qmd_chunks_total:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"QMD source preflight failed: included {qmd_chunks_included} of "
            f"{qmd_chunks_total} executable chunks. Nothing was submitted."
        )

qmd_raw_chars = len(raw_qmd)
qmd_raw_lines = count_text_lines(raw_qmd)
qmd_context_chars = len(code_context)
qmd_context_lines = count_text_lines(code_context)

source_completion_token = ""
if qmd_context_required:
    source_completion_token = sha256_text(
        "|".join(
            [
                str(qmd_sha256 or ""),
                context_mode,
                str(qmd_context_chars),
                str(qmd_chunks_total),
                code_context,
            ]
        )
    )[:32].upper()

assignment_text = cfg_str("assignment", allow_empty=True).strip()
assignment_block = (
    "\nIssues listed in 'Assignment':\n"
    "=== BEGIN ASSIGNMENT ===\n"
    f"{assignment_text}\n"
    "=== END ASSIGNMENT ===\n"
    if assignment_text else ""
)
source_manifest_block = ""
source_context_block = ""

if qmd_path is not None:
    source_manifest_block = (
        "\nQMD source integrity manifest:\n"
        f"- file: {qmd_path.name}\n"
        f"- sha256: {qmd_sha256}\n"
        f"- raw characters: {qmd_raw_chars}\n"
        f"- raw lines: {qmd_raw_lines}\n"
        f"- context mode: {context_mode}\n"
        f"- declared scope: {qmd_context_scope}\n"
        f"- context status: {qmd_context_status}\n"
        f"- context characters: {qmd_context_chars}\n"
        f"- context lines: {qmd_context_lines}\n"
        f"- executable chunks included: {qmd_chunks_included}/{qmd_chunks_total}\n"
    )

if qmd_context_required:
    source_context_block = (
        "\n=== BEGIN COMPLETE QMD SOURCE CONTEXT ===\n"
        f"{code_context}\n"
        "=== END COMPLETE QMD SOURCE CONTEXT ===\n"
        f"QMD_SOURCE_COMPLETION_TOKEN: {source_completion_token}"
    )
prompt_addendum_text = cfg_str("prompt_addendum", allow_empty=True).strip()
prompt_addendum_block = (
    f"\nAdditional reviewer instructions:\n{prompt_addendum_text}\n"
    if prompt_addendum_text else ""
)
prompt_override_text = cfg_str("prompt_override", allow_empty=True).strip()

prompt_version = "pre_human_review_v4"

source_integrity_instruction_block = """Source integrity requirements:
- When a QMD source block is supplied, read through its final `QMD_SOURCE_COMPLETION_TOKEN`.
- If that token is absent, the source block ends unexpectedly, or the manifest does not say `context status: complete`, do not perform a substantive review. Return only `## Review not completed`, one sentence stating that the QMD source could not be verified as complete, and the hidden marker `<!-- QMD_SOURCE_STATUS: INCOMPLETE -->`.
- When the complete QMD source token is visible, append `<!-- QMD_SOURCE_VERIFIED: TOKEN -->` as the final line of the response, replacing `TOKEN` with the exact token from the source footer.
- Do not mention this integrity check elsewhere in the visible review.

"""

# The review instructions live in prompt.md, next to this file; edit them there.
prompt_file = Path("prompt.md")
if not prompt_file.exists():
    raise RuntimeError("prompt.md not found next to review.qmd. Nothing was submitted.")
prompt_text = prompt_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

review_instructions = prompt_override_text if prompt_override_text else prompt_text
prompt_text = (
    source_integrity_instruction_block
    + review_instructions
    + assignment_block
    + prompt_addendum_block
    + source_manifest_block
    + source_context_block
)

if prompt_text is None:
    prompt_text = ""
if not isinstance(prompt_text, str):
    prompt_text = str(prompt_text)


prompt_sha256 = sha256_text(prompt_text)
results_root = Path("review_results")
jobs_dir = results_root / "prototype_jobs"
runs_dir = results_root / "prototype_runs"

jobs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
runs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

doc_slug = slug(doc_name)
```

**Review request**

The manual chunk streams the selected model when supported and saves a matching Markdown and JSON record.

```{python anthropic-review-manual, eval=FALSE}

import base64
from anthropic import Anthropic

model = anthropic_model
use_stream = anthropic_stream
effort = anthropic_effort
display = anthropic_display
max_tokens = max_output_tokens

if qmd_path is None and pdf_path is None:
    raise RuntimeError(
        "No input selected. Set `review_folder` plus `qmd_file` and/or `pdf_file` "
        "in `runtime-params`, then re-run the setup chunks."
    )

if effort not in {"", "low", "medium", "high", "xhigh", "max"}:
    raise RuntimeError(
        "cfg['anthropic_effort'] must be one of: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, or ''."
    )
if display not in {"", "summarized", "omitted"}:
    raise RuntimeError(
        "cfg['anthropic_display'] must be '', 'summarized', or 'omitted'."
    )
if max_tokens > 21333 and not use_stream:
    raise RuntimeError(
        "Set cfg['anthropic_stream'] = TRUE when max_output_tokens exceeds 21,333."
    )

if qmd_context_required:
    expected_footer = f"QMD_SOURCE_COMPLETION_TOKEN: {source_completion_token}"
    if qmd_context_status != "complete":
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"QMD source preflight failed with status: {qmd_context_status}. Nothing was submitted."
        )
    if prompt_text.count(expected_footer) != 1 or not prompt_text.rstrip().endswith(expected_footer):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "QMD completion footer is missing or misplaced in the assembled prompt. "
            "Nothing was submitted."
        )
    print(
        "QMD source preflight passed: "
        f"{qmd_chunks_included}/{qmd_chunks_total} executable chunks, "
        f"{qmd_context_chars:,} context characters, no truncation."
    )

content = []
if pdf_path is not None:
    pdf_b64 = base64.standard_b64encode(pdf_path.read_bytes()).decode("utf-8")
    content.append(
        {
            "type": "document",
            "source": {
                "type": "base64",
                "media_type": "application/pdf",
                "data": pdf_b64,
            },
        }
    )
content.append({"type": "text", "text": prompt_text})

client = Anthropic()
anthropic_args = {
    "model": model,
    "max_tokens": max_tokens,
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}],
    "thinking": {
        "type": "adaptive",
        **({"display": display} if display else {}),
    },
}

if effort:
    output_config = {"effort": effort}
    create_params = inspect.signature(client.messages.create).parameters
    stream_params = inspect.signature(client.messages.stream).parameters
    if "output_config" in create_params and "output_config" in stream_params:
        anthropic_args["output_config"] = output_config
    else:
        anthropic_args["extra_body"] = {"output_config": output_config}

response = None
review_text = ""

if use_stream:
    print(f"Streaming review from {model} (effort={effort or 'default'}):")
    streamed = []
    try:
        with client.messages.stream(**anthropic_args) as stream:
            for chunk in stream.text_stream:
                streamed.append(chunk)
                print(chunk, end="", flush=True)
            print()
            response = stream.get_final_message()
        review_text = "".join(streamed).strip()
    except AttributeError as exc:
        if max_tokens > 21333:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "This SDK does not expose streaming, but the configured max_output_tokens requires it."
            ) from exc
        print("Streaming is unavailable in this SDK; using a non-streaming request.")
        use_stream = False

if not use_stream:
    response = client.messages.create(**anthropic_args)

if response is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Anthropic returned no final message; no result was saved.")

response_dict = obj_to_dict(response)
response_id = response_dict.get("id") or getattr(response, "id", None)
actual_model = response_dict.get("model") or getattr(response, "model", None) or model
stop_reason = response_dict.get("stop_reason") or getattr(response, "stop_reason", None)
stop_details_obj = response_dict.get("stop_details") or getattr(response, "stop_details", None)
stop_details = obj_to_dict(stop_details_obj) if stop_details_obj is not None else None

if not review_text:
    text_parts = []
    for block in getattr(response, "content", []):
        block_dict = obj_to_dict(block)
        if block_dict.get("type", getattr(block, "type", None)) == "text":
            text_parts.append(block_dict.get("text") or getattr(block, "text", ""))
    review_text = "\n".join(text_parts).strip()

raw_review_text = review_text
source_context_verified = None

if stop_reason == "refusal":
    category = (stop_details or {}).get("category") or "not specified"
    explanation = (stop_details or {}).get("explanation") or "No explanation was returned."
    review_text = (
        "## Review not completed\n\n"
        f"The selected model returned a classifier refusal (`{category}`). {explanation}\n\n"
        "No review conclusion should be inferred from this response."
    )
    status = "refused"
elif stop_reason == "max_tokens":
    if not review_text:
        raise RuntimeError("Anthropic stopped at max_tokens without returning usable text.")
    review_text = (
        "## Review not completed\n\n"
        "The model response reached the output-token limit before completion. "
        "No substantive review should be relied upon from this run."
    )
    status = "incomplete_max_tokens"
else:
    if not review_text:
        raise RuntimeError("Anthropic returned no text content; no result was saved.")
    status = "completed"

if qmd_context_required and status == "completed":
    verification_marker = f"<!-- QMD_SOURCE_VERIFIED: {source_completion_token} -->"
    incomplete_marker = "<!-- QMD_SOURCE_STATUS: INCOMPLETE -->"

    if incomplete_marker in review_text:
        source_context_verified = False
        review_text = (
            "## Review not completed\n\n"
            "The model reported that it could not verify receipt of the complete QMD source. "
            "No substantive source or code review should be relied upon from this run."
        )
        status = "incomplete_source_context"
    elif verification_marker not in review_text:
        source_context_verified = False
        review_text = (
            "## Review not completed\n\n"
            "The response did not return the QMD source-completion token, so complete source "
            "receipt could not be verified. No substantive source or code review should be "
            "relied upon from this run."
        )
        status = "unverified_source_context"
    else:
        source_context_verified = True
        review_text = review_text.replace(verification_marker, "").strip()
elif qmd_context_required:
    source_context_verified = False

reasoning_snippets = extract_anthropic_reasoning(response)
usage = response_dict.get("usage") or getattr(response, "usage", None)
input_tokens = anthropic_usage_value(usage, "input_tokens")
output_tokens = anthropic_usage_value(usage, "output_tokens")

stamp = now_utc_stamp()
base = f"{doc_slug}_anthropic_{slug(model)}_{stamp}"
md_path = runs_dir / f"{base}.md"
json_path = runs_dir / f"{base}.json"

md_content = (
    "# Pre-Human Review Output\n\n"
    f"- Prompt version: {prompt_version}\n"
    "- Provider: anthropic\n"
    f"- Requested model: {model}\n"
    f"- Served model: {actual_model}\n"
    f"- response_id: {response_id}\n"
    f"- status: {status}\n"
    f"- stop_reason: {stop_reason or '(n/a)'}\n"
    f"- stream: {use_stream}\n"
    "- thinking: adaptive\n"
    f"- display: {display or '(default)'}\n"
    f"- effort: {effort or '(default)'}\n"
    f"- max_tokens: {max_tokens}\n"
    f"- input_tokens: {input_tokens}\n"
    f"- output_tokens: {output_tokens}\n"
    f"- prompt_sha256: {prompt_sha256}\n"
    f"- qmd_sha256: {qmd_sha256 or '(n/a)'}\n"
    f"- pdf_sha256: {pdf_sha256 or '(n/a)'}\n"
    f"- qmd_context_mode: {context_mode}\n"
    f"- qmd_context_status: {qmd_context_status}\n"
    f"- qmd_context_verified: {source_context_verified if source_context_verified is not None else '(n/a)'}\n"
    f"- qmd_context_chars: {qmd_context_chars}\n"
    f"- qmd_chunks_included: {qmd_chunks_included}/{qmd_chunks_total}\n\n"
    "## Review\n\n"
    f"{review_text}\n"
)
md_path.write_text(md_content, encoding="utf-8")

payload = {
    "prompt_version": prompt_version,
    "provider": "anthropic",
    "requested_model": model,
    "model": actual_model,
    "response_id": response_id,
    "status": status,
    "stop_reason": stop_reason,
    "stop_details": stop_details,
    "stream": use_stream,
    "thinking": "adaptive",
    "display": display or None,
    "effort": effort or None,
    "max_tokens": max_tokens,
    "input_tokens": input_tokens,
    "output_tokens": output_tokens,
    "prompt_sha256": prompt_sha256,
    "assignment": assignment_text or None,
    "qmd_sha256": qmd_sha256,
    "pdf_sha256": pdf_sha256,
    "qmd_context_mode": context_mode,
    "qmd_context_scope": qmd_context_scope,
    "qmd_context_status": qmd_context_status,
    "qmd_context_verified": source_context_verified,
    "qmd_raw_chars": qmd_raw_chars,
    "qmd_raw_lines": qmd_raw_lines,
    "qmd_context_chars": qmd_context_chars,
    "qmd_context_lines": qmd_context_lines,
    "qmd_chunks_total": qmd_chunks_total,
    "qmd_chunks_included": qmd_chunks_included,
    "review_text": review_text,
    "raw_review_text": raw_review_text if raw_review_text != review_text else None,
    "reasoning_snippets": reasoning_snippets,
    "saved_at": now_utc_iso(),
    "pdf_path": str(pdf_path) if pdf_path else None,
    "qmd_path": str(qmd_path) if qmd_path else None,
}
json_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

print(f"saved markdown: {md_path}")
print(f"saved json: {json_path}")
```

```{python load-latest-results, echo=FALSE}

def latest_for(provider: str, expected_model: str = "") -> dict:
    matches = sorted(
        runs_dir.glob(f"{doc_slug}_{provider}_*.json"),
        key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime,
        reverse=True
    )
    base = {
        "path": "",
        "meta": {},
        "text": "",
        "expected_model": expected_model,
    }
    if not matches:
        return base

    expected = str(expected_model or "").strip()
    for path in matches:
        meta = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        model_val = str(meta.get("model", "")).strip()
        if expected and model_val != expected:
            continue
        text = str(meta.get("review_text", "")).strip()
        return {
            "path": str(path),
            "meta": meta,
            "text": text,
            "expected_model": expected_model,
        }

    return base

latest_anthropic = latest_for("anthropic", expected_model=anthropic_model)

## Review Output

```{r show-latest-results, results="asis", echo=FALSE}

show_result <- function(label, py_obj) {
  path <- py_obj$path
  expected_model <- if (is.null(py_obj$expected_model)) "" else as.character(py_obj$expected_model)

  if (is.null(path) || path == "") {
    cat("::: {.review-result .review-box}\n")
    cat("<span class='review-label'><i class='bi bi-file-earmark-check' aria-hidden='true'></i> ", label, "</span>\n\n", sep = "")
    if (nzchar(trimws(expected_model))) {
      cat("_No saved result found for configured model `", expected_model, "`._\n", sep = "")
    } else {
      cat("_No saved result found._\n")
    }
    cat("\n:::\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  lr <- py_obj$meta
  review_txt <- py_obj$text
  val_or <- function(x, default = "(n/a)") {
    if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x[[1]]) || identical(x[[1]], "")) default else x[[1]]
  }

  extract_major_issue_preview <- function(txt) {
    if (is.null(txt) || !nzchar(trimws(txt))) return(character(0))
    lines <- unlist(strsplit(txt, "\n", fixed = TRUE))
    trimmed <- trimws(lines)
    start_idx <- grep("^##\\s*Major Issues\\s*$", trimmed, ignore.case = TRUE)
    if (length(start_idx) == 0) return(character(0))
    start <- start_idx[1] + 1
    next_heads <- grep("^##\\s+", trimmed)
    next_heads <- next_heads[next_heads > start_idx[1]]
    end <- if (length(next_heads) > 0) next_heads[1] - 1 else length(lines)
    if (start > end) return(character(0))
    block <- lines[start:end]
    items <- block[grepl("^\\s*[0-9]+\\.\\s+", block)]
    items <- sub("^\\s*[0-9]+\\.\\s+", "", items)
    items <- trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", items))
    items[nzchar(items)]
  }

  is_html <- knitr::is_html_output()
  meta_df <- data.frame(
    Field = c(
      "File", "Model", "Status", "QMD source", "QMD chunks",
      "Stop reason", "Response ID", "Input tokens", "Output tokens", "Saved at"
    ),
    Value = c(
      basename(path),
      val_or(lr$model),
      val_or(lr$status),
      if (is.null(lr$qmd_context_verified)) {
        val_or(lr$qmd_context_status)
      } else if (isTRUE(lr$qmd_context_verified)) {
        "complete and verified"
      } else {
        "not verified"
      },
      paste0(val_or(lr$qmd_chunks_included, "0"), "/", val_or(lr$qmd_chunks_total, "0")),
      val_or(lr$stop_reason),
      val_or(lr$response_id),
      val_or(as.character(lr$input_tokens), "0"),
      val_or(as.character(lr$output_tokens), "0"),
      val_or(lr$saved_at)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  if (is_html) {
    token_rows <- meta_df$Field %in% c("Input tokens", "Output tokens")
    meta_df$Value[token_rows] <- paste0("<span class='meta-num'>", meta_df$Value[token_rows], "</span>")
  }

  major_preview <- extract_major_issue_preview(review_txt)

  cat("::: {.review-result .review-box}\n")
  cat("<span class='review-label'><i class='bi bi-file-earmark-check' aria-hidden='true'></i> ", label, "</span>\n\n", sep = "")

  if (is_html) {
    cat("<details class='review-meta'>\n")
    cat("<summary><i class='bi bi-table' aria-hidden='true'></i> Show metadata</summary>\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(
      meta_df,
      col.names = c("Field", "Value"),
      align = c("l", "l"),
      escape = FALSE,
      table.attr = "class='meta-table'"
    ))
    cat("\n</details>\n\n")
  } else {
    print(knitr::kable(meta_df, col.names = c("Field", "Value"), align = c("l", "l")))
    cat("\n")
  }

  cat("<div class='review-subhead'><i class='bi bi-exclamation-diamond' aria-hidden='true'></i> Major Issues</div>\n\n")
  if (length(major_preview) == 0) {
    cat("_No major issues could be parsed from the saved review._\n\n")
  } else {
    for (i in seq_along(major_preview)) cat(i, ". ", major_preview[[i]], "\n", sep = "")
    cat("\n")
  }

  cat("<div class='review-subhead'><i class='bi bi-file-earmark-text' aria-hidden='true'></i> Full Review</div>\n\n")
  if (is.null(review_txt) || !nzchar(trimws(review_txt))) {
    cat("_The saved review is empty._\n")
  } else {
    cat(review_txt, "\n", sep = "")
  }
  cat("\n:::\n\n")
}

get_cost_row <- function(py_obj) {
  path <- py_obj$path
  if (is.null(path) || path == "") return(NULL)

  lr <- py_obj$meta
  model <- ifelse(is.null(lr$model) || lr$model == "", NA_character_, as.character(lr$model))
  in_tok <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ifelse(is.null(lr$input_tokens), NA, lr$input_tokens)))
  out_tok <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ifelse(is.null(lr$output_tokens), NA, lr$output_tokens)))

  rates <- cfg$pricing_usd_per_1m
  rate_row <- rates[rates$model == model, , drop = FALSE]
  input_rate <- if (nrow(rate_row) > 0) as.numeric(rate_row$input[1]) else NA_real_
  output_rate <- if (nrow(rate_row) > 0) as.numeric(rate_row$output[1]) else NA_real_
  pricing_found <- !is.na(input_rate) && !is.na(output_rate)

  stop_reason <- ifelse(is.null(lr$stop_reason) || lr$stop_reason == "", "", as.character(lr$stop_reason))
  pre_output_refusal <- identical(stop_reason, "refusal") && !is.na(out_tok) && out_tok == 0

  input_cost <- if (pre_output_refusal) {
    0
  } else if (!is.na(in_tok) && !is.na(input_rate)) {
    (in_tok / 1e6) * input_rate
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
  output_cost <- if (pre_output_refusal) {
    0
  } else if (!is.na(out_tok) && !is.na(output_rate)) {
    (out_tok / 1e6) * output_rate
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
  est_cost <- if (!is.na(input_cost) && !is.na(output_cost)) {
    input_cost + output_cost
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  data.frame(
    Model = model,
    InputTokens = ifelse(is.na(in_tok), 0, in_tok),
    OutputTokens = ifelse(is.na(out_tok), 0, out_tok),
    InputRateUSDper1M = input_rate,
    OutputRateUSDper1M = output_rate,
    InputCostUSD = input_cost,
    OutputCostUSD = output_cost,
    PricingFound = pricing_found,
    EstimatedCostUSD = est_cost,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

cost_rows <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), list(
  get_cost_row(py$latest_anthropic)
)))

if (is.null(cost_rows) || nrow(cost_rows) == 0) {
  cat("No saved results available yet for cost estimation.")
} else {
  missing_models <- unique(cost_rows$Model[!cost_rows$PricingFound])
  if (length(missing_models) > 0) {
    cat("Pricing not found for: ", paste(missing_models, collapse = ", "), ". Add these models in `cfg$pricing_usd_per_1m`.\n\n", sep = "")
  }

  cost_display <- cost_rows
  cost_display$InputTokens <- format(round(cost_display$InputTokens), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
  cost_display$OutputTokens <- format(round(cost_display$OutputTokens), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
  cost_display$InputRateUSDper1M <- ifelse(is.na(cost_display$InputRateUSDper1M), "(missing)", sprintf("$%.2f", cost_display$InputRateUSDper1M))
  cost_display$OutputRateUSDper1M <- ifelse(is.na(cost_display$OutputRateUSDper1M), "(missing)", sprintf("$%.2f", cost_display$OutputRateUSDper1M))
  cost_display$InputCostUSD <- ifelse(is.na(cost_display$InputCostUSD), "(n/a)", sprintf("$%.4f", cost_display$InputCostUSD))
  cost_display$OutputCostUSD <- ifelse(is.na(cost_display$OutputCostUSD), "(n/a)", sprintf("$%.4f", cost_display$OutputCostUSD))
  cost_display$EstimatedCostUSD <- ifelse(is.na(cost_display$EstimatedCostUSD), "(n/a)", sprintf("$%.4f", cost_display$EstimatedCostUSD))
  cost_display$PricingFound <- NULL

  render_ft <- function(df, header_labels = NULL, right_cols = character(), center_cols = character(), footer_lines = character()) {
    ft <- flextable::flextable(df)
    if (!is.null(header_labels)) {
      valid_headers <- header_labels[names(header_labels) %in% names(df)]
      if (length(valid_headers) > 0) {
        ft <- flextable::set_header_labels(ft, values = valid_headers)
      }
    }
    right_cols <- intersect(right_cols, names(df))
    if (length(right_cols) > 0) {
      ft <- flextable::align(ft, align = "right", part = "all", j = right_cols)
    }
    center_cols <- intersect(center_cols, names(df))
    if (length(center_cols) > 0) {
      ft <- flextable::align(ft, align = "center", part = "all", j = center_cols)
    }
    ft <- flextable::theme_vanilla(ft)
    if (length(footer_lines) > 0) {
      ft <- flextable::add_footer_lines(ft, values = footer_lines)
      ft <- flextable::fontsize(ft, size = 9, part = "footer")
      ft <- flextable::align(ft, align = "left", part = "footer")
    }
    ft <- flextable::autofit(ft)
    ft_html <- knitr::knit_print(ft)
    cat(as.character(ft_html), "\n")
    invisible(ft)
  }

  if (knitr::is_html_output() && !requireNamespace("flextable", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Please install 'flextable' for HTML rendering: install.packages('flextable')")
  }

  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    render_ft(
      cost_display,
      header_labels = c(
        Model = "Model",
        InputTokens = "Input Tokens",
        OutputTokens = "Output Tokens",
        InputRateUSDper1M = "Input Rate / 1M",
        OutputRateUSDper1M = "Output Rate / 1M",
        InputCostUSD = "Input Cost",
        OutputCostUSD = "Output Cost",
        EstimatedCostUSD = "Estimated Total"
      ),
      right_cols = c("InputTokens", "OutputTokens", "InputRateUSDper1M", "OutputRateUSDper1M", "InputCostUSD", "OutputCostUSD", "EstimatedCostUSD"),
      footer_lines = character()
    )
  } else {
    print(knitr::kable(
      cost_display,
      col.names = c(
        "Model", "Input Tokens", "Output Tokens",
        "Input Rate / 1M", "Output Rate / 1M",
        "Input Cost", "Output Cost", "Estimated Total"
      ),
      align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")
    ))
  }

}
